column1: # The cases of one suite job: suite, chunk, the case names (space-separated),
# ` | ` between the workers omg_suite.py runs at the same time, each on DDS
# domains of its own.
# `smoke` is the merge scenario (ci/interop_scenarios.py), one worker: one case
# of most families of dds-rtps, with RELIABLE cases (Reliability_3/4,
# Durability_5/17; OPEN-ITEMS 1 names that class of failure), the three new
# cases of dds-rtps PR #105 that take seconds (Topic_2, Cft_2, Partition_4),
# and no presentation case (Cyclone reports PUB/SUB_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE for all
# of them in its own self-run). Measured on the Linux test host, 2026-10-31,
# with five pairs running beside it: 16 cases with History_2, Partition_3,
# LargeData_1 and TimeBasedFilter_0 took 332 and 335 s, these four 216 s of it.
# The other chunks are cut by cut_chunks.py into workers of at most 125 s
# (dds-rtps), 115 s (dds-xtypes) and 95 s (dds-security) of cases, four to a
# chunk, the budgets chosen so that every chunk is full, from the longest
# duration each case took in these
# reports: dds-rtps from ZeroDDS against Cyclone 11.0.1, Fast DDS 3.6.1 and
# Connext 7.7.0 in both directions on the Linux test host (2026-11-01, harness
# 863b86f97ce, 20 suite runs at the same time, 484 cases, all passed) and in
# CI (pipelines 8510 and 8515); dds-xtypes from ZeroDDS against Cyclone in both
# directions on the Linux test host (2026-11-01, harness 5a6454ad631, 656
# cases, the 7 declared ones run alone); dds-security from ZeroDDS against
# Connext 7.7 and CoreDX 6.14.1 in both directions on the Linux test host
# (2026-11-01, suite 62f5ec4, 1100 cells, run_matrix.py ending the wait when a
# refused reader or writer exits). A job is the longest of its workers, and
# spends 8 to 12 s outside its cases on an idle runner (pipeline 8548), up to
# 111 s while another project's jobs load the CI runner host (job 227666, pipeline 8561:
# 71 s preparing the executor, 29 s starting the script). With 200 s of cases
# that job reached the 5-minute timeout; at most 125 s leave room for 127 s,
# the most measured outside the cases (job 227444, pipeline 8510).
# What each vendor runs (internal/release/rc8-test-suite.md, "Interop", B3: a
# property is checked once, with the strongest oracle). A case checks two
# things about ZeroDDS: its own behaviour under the case's QoS (matching by
# requested and offered QoS, ownership, filters, history, lifespan, deadline,
# presentation), which is the same code whichever vendor is the peer, and the
# vendor's dialect of the wire elements the case uses (discovery, the QoS
# parameters of the case's family, the reliable protocol, fragments, status
# info, timestamps), which differs per vendor. The behaviour runs once, in
# both directions, against a reference; every other vendor runs the cases that
# carry its dialect, one per family:
# - dds-rtps: Cyclone runs every case (`rtps-1` to `rtps-3`; it skips the
#   presentation families it fails against itself). `rtps-vendor-1`, the
#   dialect cases: discovery and a best-effort reader (Domain_0), XCDR1 and
#   XCDR2 (DataRepresentation_0, _3), the reliable protocol (Reliability_4),
#   OWNERSHIP_STRENGTH (Ownership_3), DEADLINE (Deadline_1), three topics on
#   one participant (Topic_2), the content filter property (Cft_2), a named and
#   the default partition (Partition_0, _4), the history of a TRANSIENT_LOCAL
#   writer to a late joiner (Durability_17), GAPs of a KEEP_LAST writer
#   (History_0), DATA_FRAG and NACK_FRAG (LargeData_0), LIFESPAN with the
#   source timestamps (Lifespan_0), unregister, dispose and the end of a writer
#   (FinalInstanceState_0 to _2). Fast DDS runs `rtps-vendor-1`; Connext runs
#   `rtps-presentation-1`, the same cases and the presentation families
#   (OrderedAccess, CoherentSets), which only Connext of the three runs. The
#   cases not run against Fast DDS and Connext check, on ZeroDDS' side,
#   behaviour the Cyclone run checks with the same oracle: requested against
#   offered QoS (Durability_0 to _15, Reliability_1/_2, Ownership_0 to _2,
#   Deadline_0/_2, DataRepresentation_1/_2), the domain's ports (Domain_1/_2),
#   partition and filter matching (Partition_1 to _3, Cft_0/_1), instances and
#   durations of the same QoS (Reliability_5, Ownership_4 to _6, History_1/_2,
#   Lifespan_1 to _7, Durability_16, Deadline_3), TIME_BASED_FILTER, a reader
#   QoS a writer does not see; Reliability_0 and LargeData_1 are best effort
#   without repair, whose wire Domain_0 and LargeData_0 carry. Cut from the
#   reports of pipeline 8823 (all vendors, both directions; `rtps-vendor`
#   with workers of at most 60 s, so that the four share the cases).
# - dds-security: Connext runs `security-access-1`: the 25 combinations of
#   reader and writer permissions under the three access-control governances
#   without protection (PD_RA_OM_OD, PD_WA_OM_OD, PD_RWA_OM_OD), and the eight
#   other protection kinds of PD_RWA (signed or encrypted metadata and data)
#   with both permissions AllowAll. The other 192 cells repeat a permission
#   combination under a protection kind: a refused endpoint shows no
#   communication with or without encryption, and an allowed one takes the
#   protection path its AllowAll cell takes. CoreDX runs
#   `security-protection-1`: the eleven governances with both permissions
#   AllowAll, its handshake, key exchange and transforms for every protection
#   kind. Cut from the reports of pipeline 8823 (Connext, and CoreDX for
#   `security-protection-1`), workers of at most 70 and 15 s.
# - dds-xtypes runs against Cyclone only, every case.
# - Cyclone DDS master beside its release (GitHub #60; ci/Dockerfile.omg builds
#   its clients at CYCLONEDDS_MASTER_COMMIT): dds-rtps `rtps-vendor-1`, as
#   Fast DDS, its dialect of the wire elements; dds-xtypes `xtypes-master-1`,
#   the families whose code changed between the release's build and master
#   (union labels, discriminators and their keys, mutable unions, defaults,
#   try-construct, assignability by widening and of keys and member ids,
#   enumerations): the union suite (34), the try-construct cases of unions
#   and enumerations (17), the extensibility suite without its two final
#   structs (12), the struct suite without its three plain primitive structs
#   and the three key cases Cyclone fails against itself (24), type widening
#   (9), the enumeration arrays and sequence (3); 99 cases. Not run against
#   master: the primitive, string and the other array and sequence cases,
#   the bound, name and validation cases of type consistency, the
#   try-construct cases of plain sequences and strings and the final
#   structs, families that no commit between the two builds names (read
#   from the commit titles of Cyclone's master, not measured). Cut from the
#   reports of pipeline 9037 (Cyclone 11.0.1) and of master on the Linux
#   test host (2026-11-03, both directions), workers of at most 115 s.
#   The dds-xtypes group runs on a release candidate and when the pin moves,
#   not weekly: its 99 cases gave the results of the same cases against
#   11.0.1 (pipelines 9097, 9170, 9186; ci/interop-omg-weekly.yml).
# suite
